sourceCopy.name: VCard Generator
sourceCopy.title: VCard Generator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Create a vCard 3.0 or 4.0 contact file with escaped Unicode text and optional photo. Preview, copy or download it locally.
sourceCopy.intro: Create a single digital contact as a .vcf file in your browser. Choose vCard 3.0 or 4.0, add contact details and optionally embed a small JPEG or PNG photo.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: Will this add the contact to my phone?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: No. It creates a VCF file for you to preview, copy or download. It never reads or changes your address book; you decide whether and where to import the file.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Details and an optional photo are processed on this device. There is no upload, account, server processing or automatic saving.

fields.title: Job title
fields.phones: Phone numbers (one per line, up to 5)
fields.emails: Email addresses (one per line, up to 5)
fields.photoHint: Optional JPEG or PNG, up to 128 KiB. The photo is embedded into the VCF file; it is not uploaded.
fields.limits: One contact, up to 5 phones and 5 emails, 500 characters per text field, and a 1 MiB generated-file limit. Only vCard 3.0 and 4.0 are offered.
fields.privacyNote: Runs locally after you choose Generate. No account, contact-book access, upload, API, server processing or automatic save.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between vCard 3.0 and 4.0?
additionalFaqs.answer: They are two versions of the vCard contact format. The tool writes a compatible VCF text file using the version you select; contact apps may support them differently.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this verify phone numbers or email addresses?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It checks their basic format only. It cannot verify that a number, mailbox, address or website belongs to the person.
